title: A case against a business person due to social media sharing
paragraphs: A business person has been indicted on charges of public spread of misleading information due to his sharing of social media accounts in Bursa.
It was suggested that the products of a food producer were toxic.
The indictment has been passed by the 3rd Criminal Court of Asliye. The sentence is carried out by the Turkish Penal Code 217/A (publicly spreading misleading information).
The defendant runs a textile company on his behalf, not a journalist.
The first hearing will take place in May, and the defendant's attorney denies the allegations.
